seo.title: Partner with SeaNeB News | Scale Your Digital News Reach
seo.description: Join the SeaNeB News ecosystem. Partner with us to empower local journalists and expand your digital presence in hyperlocal news.

questions.q: How can I partner with SeaNeB News?
questions.a: You can partner with SeaNeB News by registering as a news contributor, submitting verification details, and getting editorial approval to publish verified local news.

questions.q: Who can become a partner on SeaNeB News?
questions.a: Independent journalists, local reporters, small news agencies, and regional publishers can become partners after verification.

hero.intro: SeaNeB News is India’s emerging hyperlocal digital news platform designed to amplify city-wise, district-level, and community-driven journalism.

process_steps: Get approval from the editorial team

benefits.title: National Visibility
benefits.description: Your regional news reaches a wider digital audience across India.

benefits.title: Verified System
benefits.description: We maintain editorial review and verification to protect credibility.
